Name: Jodi and Vincent - Sprites and Portraits Remastered
Author: Shadowfire1223
Description:
Chello, all!

Oh boy.

One of the things that really bugged me was Jodi's hair. In her portrait, it matches her son's; on her sprite, it's...brown. So! I did a cleanup of her sprite, then decided to recolour it (strawberry blonde???), THEN decided to do one each of the brown and the strawberry. Then decided to add the brown hair to her portrait, because I'm a masochist.

I'm including Vincent here with her because I also recoloured his sprite and portrait to offer a brown-haired option, as well as cleaned the originals of both! So if anyone vehemently dislikes the strawberry, they can choose to make them both brown-haired.

This was my first attempt at editing pixel art, and to be honest, it's kinda fun! Might have to try others...

Please enjoy!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1552/?]See my Caroline sprite here![/url]

[color=red]*This is the only place I've uploaded these files.*[/color]
